title: KMC(KFC Mod)
description: MMMMMHHH KMC ! (KFC MOD, with Chicken butcket and golden Chicken bucket)
body:
Welcome to the KMC MOD!

- You have an 8% chance of getting a golden ticket when you eat a KMChicken bucket
- With the golden ticket you have a 3% chance of getting the golden KMChicken bucket and 1% chance of getting the Fat KMChicken bucket
- When you eat the golden KMChicken bucket, a rain of minerals follows you for 10 seconds
- When you eat the Fat KMChicken bucket, you become fat and can crush any entity in your path for 1 minute and 30 seconds.

PLEASE VISIT THE GALLERY FOR MORE INFORMATION !
